The instrument has a long U-shaped tube structure with metal keys and a curved metal neck (bocal) at the top. The background includes a draped maroon fabric.

The maroon fabric in the upper left has slightly unnatural, painterly folds that don't fully resolve into crisp geometric shadows, typical of AI background generation.
